performance_links.scope_note: Exact finite-trajectory derivative, all components; no rate or unrestricted oracle-complexity guarantee.

variants.cost: Charge T state-map evaluations; at each t charge the A_t Z_{t-1} and B_t derivative work, matrix addition and storage, plus a terminal ∇E evaluation and its product with Z_T. A column implementation uses m state-direction products and m parameter-direction products per t, with any shared AD work accounted for by the implementation. Explicit dense storage of Z costs dm scalars (plus current state, buffers and derivative workspace); explicit A_t/B_t materialization costs additional d²/dm storage if chosen. Local operation accounting, not a unit-cost oracle rate. The paper's Section 4 AD time/space assertions are not imported as a separately certified bound.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p. 3 Algorithm 2 and Eq. (11); pp. 3–4 Eqs. (12)–(15); p. 4 Section 4 explains derivative-product accounting.
variants.name: Fixed-lambda Forward-HG
variants.output: Return the row g=∇E(s_T)Z_T∈R^{1×m}, with all m components. The printed Algorithm 2 return E(s) is interpreted at terminal s_T using Eqs. (12),(15).
public_inputs: d,m,T positive integers; lambda∈R^m fixed throughout the pass; initial state s_0∈R^d independent of lambda.
Differentiable terminal E:R^d→R and smooth update maps Phi_t:R^d×R^m→R^d, t=1,...,T.
Implementations of Phi_t and its state/parameter derivatives or equivalent Jacobian-vector products; gradient evaluation for E.
variants.query_and_update: For t=1,...,T, at the old state s_{t-1} and fixed lambda evaluate s_t=Phi_t(s_{t-1},lambda), A_t=D_s Phi_t(s_{t-1},lambda), B_t=D_lambda Phi_t(s_{t-1},lambda). Set Z_t=A_t Z_{t-1}+B_t and overwrite the previous state/sensitivity after their uses. Equivalently, for each column j obtain A_t Z_{t-1}[:,j] and B_t[:,j] via derivative products; do not evaluate derivatives at the new state.
variants.requirements: All selected Lemma conditions apply. Derivative operations for the actual update maps must be available; a function-value or first-order loss oracle alone need not supply them. The maps and terminal objective are defined and differentiable along the trajectory.
variants.state_and_initialization: Set s=s_0 and Z=0_{d×m}. Keep the previous state and previous Z until their updates have been computed. No trajectory buffer is required by this recurrence.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Stop after the prescribed finite T. No outer optimization step, learning-rate choice, accuracy stopping rule or convergence-to-inner-minimizer criterion is supplied by this variant.
